If destination is a directory, source will be copied into destination. So we can do cp source=Quarter1_Reports/file.txt destination=Archived_Quarter1. That copies file into that directory. So we can iterate.

But we can't easily iterate in this environment. We can call find to get list, then manually copy each. Let's call find.
